Commentary.Commentary: SOUTH AFRICA HAVE DECLARED! Wow, that came out of nowhere. A fantastic Test match so far for the home team. After losing the toss yesterday, they were sent in to bat. Dean Elgar (199) and debutant Aiden Markram (97) made good use of a batting-friendly pitch and laid a strong platform. It was followed by yet another gigantic stand (215) between Elgar and Amla (137). Bangladesh were listless in the field and will be relieved that the declaration has come. Have to admit, it took all of us by surprise. Let's see how Bangladesh respond with the bat under overcast conditions. Big test against the likes of Morne Morkel and Kagiso Rabada awaits. Stay tuned...
...Day 2, third session...

A session which brought some success for Bangladesh but all too late. Hashim Amla was the first wicket to fall and then Dean Elgar got dismissed on 199. The Bangla bowlers tried to stifle the home side's progress after that but the current batting pair has settled in and is scoring at a decent rate as well. South Africa have strengthened their position in this Test match and are nearing 500 now. How many more will they want before declaring? Do join us in a short while to find out.

In the end, he plays a half-pull and that proves to be his undoing. The ball takes the top edge and skies over in the mid-wicket region. Mominul Haque, takes a couple of steps back and gobbles the cherry with a reverse cup. Such a sad time to get out, just a run short of his maiden double ton. Even his teammates in the dressing room can't believe it and have their hands on head. Nonetheless, it was a top, top innings from Elgar. He walks away disappointed but acknowledges the applause of the crowd.

This session - 27 Overs, 113 Runs and 0 Wickets! Needless to say who bossed. South Africa are in a commanding position here with Elgar and Amla looking set to get a double ton under their belt. They are amidst a mammoth 215-run stand and are showing no signs of slowing down. The Bangladesh bowlers find themselves helpless against the hosts' top order and have been made to work hard for everything, without much luck. The hosts have one motto - bat once but bat big! Let's see how much they will feel is enough before having a go with the cherry. Join us in a bit for the next session...

FOUR! Outside off this time, Elgar is done with his defence. He steps out of the crease, reaches to the pitch of the ball and lofts it over the mid on region for a boundary.
Fuller outside off, Elgar comes down the track and drives it towards covers.
Loopy ball outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Amla lunges forward and defends it.
Sprayed into the pads, clipped through square leg for a single.
Floated fuller in line of the stumps, driven towards long on for a single.
Short delivery outside off, Amla punches it through covers for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Amla shuffles across and defends it on the leg side.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Amla shoulders his arms to it.
Fuller delivery around off, angling away. Amla covers his stumps and lets it through to the keeper.
Another short delivery outside off, pushed through point for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, crashed through point for a single.
Drifting into the pads, clipped towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
In line of the stumps, Elgar lunges forward and defends it.
Sprayed into the pads, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Second of the over! Floats it outside off, Amla reaches the pitch of the ball and drives it through the cover region for a boundary. Easily done.
Fuller into the pads, Amla clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
FOUR! Floats it outside off, spinning into the batsman. Amla camps back a touch and smashes it through the cover region for a boundary.
Fuller delivery outside off, Elgar drives it straight back to the bowler.
Good length delivery around off, dabbed through point for a single.
Again a fuller delivery outside off, Amla this time chooses to drive it through covers. The batsmen run a couple.
FOUR! Pierced! Bowls it fuller outside off, Amla plays it really late with an angled bat. Places it beautifully through the backward point region for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery, angling into the batsman. Amla pushes it towards the fielder at covers.
Good length delivery outside off, Amla gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Elgar camps back and punches it on the leg side.
Floated beautifully around off, spinning away. The ball stays low and takes Elgar by surprise. Dean still manages to defend it off the bottom half.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Flatter and spinning away from around middle and off, Elgar gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Outside off, Dean presses forward and pushes it towards covers.
Tossed up fuller outside off, Elgar leans forward and drives it back to the bowler.
Fuller outside off, Amla shuffles across, leans forward and defends it neatly.
Length delivery outside off, Amla stays in his crease and drives it towards the fielder at covers.
Good length delivery around off, Amla gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
FOUR! Top shot! Back of a length delivery outside off, Amla hops a bit in his crease and crashes it over the point region for a boundary.
Good length delivery outside off, Amla shoulders his arms to it.
Fuller delivery outside off, driven towards the fielder at point.
Floated fuller outside off, driven towards the fielder at covers.
Angling into the batsman, Dean stays in his crease and defends it.
Flatter around off, spinning away. Elgar chooses to leave it at the last moment.
Drifting into the batsman, Elgar stays in his crease and defends it neatly.
Fuller outside off, driven back to the bowler.
FOUR! In the gap! Floats this one fuller outside off, Elgar prods forward and drives it through covers for the first boundary of the day.
Mehedi Hasan to bowl from the other end.
Fuller length outside off, Amla prods forward and skies his bat to make a leave.
Comes around the wicket, on a good length. Amla is not interested at it.
The commentator on air says that it is quite windy out there and there are predictions for thunderstorms later in the day.
Outside off on a good length, Amla shoulders his arms to it.
Good length delivery outside off, defended towards gully off the back foot.
Again fuller outside off, Amla goes after it and drives it towards the fielder at point.
Starts with a fuller delivery outside off, Amla shuffles across and lets it through to the keeper.
The players are making their way out in the middle. Mustafizur Rahman to bowl first up to Hashim Amla. A slip and a gully in place. Here we go...

Bangladesh on the other hand will need to turn around things as quickly as possible to stay relevant. The first hour of the game will be crucial with the new ball being still young. A lot will depend on how Mustafizur bowls. Stay tuned as the first ball of the day isn't far away.

Hello and a warm welcome to the second day of the 1st Test between South Africa and Bangladesh in Potchefstroom. The hosts are in cruise control of the ship, all thanks to a fantastic opening stand between Elgar and Markram. They will look to keep on piling runs to take the visitors completely out of the game.
... Day 2, Session 1 ...

Bangladesh had a torrid day on the field. Mushfiqur Rahim's decision to bowl first on this pitch raised a few eyebrows and the visitors now will be regretting that call. Their bowlers were flavorless and never were penetrating enough. A tough return catch that Amla offered to Sabbir was the only moment they got close to taking a wicket today. A big task ahead of them tomorrow and they will hope to bounce back after a forgetful day. Do join us at 1000 local (0800 GMT) for all the action.

100 runs in the session and South Africa complete the day's play handsomely on top. Apart from losing the toss, they won everything today. Dean Elgar and debutant Aiden Markram provided a big partnership up front and a miscommunication between the two saw the latter getting run out on 97. Bangladesh would have hoped to do some more damage but Hashim Amla joined forces with Elgar to shut the doors completely on the Asian team.
A touch flatter and around middle, Elgar keeps it out safely on the leg side. That will be stumps on day 1!
Loopy and full around middle, Elgar presses forward and defends it solidly.
Full and on middle, Elgar takes a big stride forward and defends it with his bat and pad together.
Leans forward and defends a full ball to covers.
Tossed up ball outside off, staying a bit low, Dean goes back and taps it down to the off side.
FOUR! Hundred stand comes up! Flighted full ball outside off, Elgar strides forward and drives it crisply through extra cover for a boundary.
Mehedi Hasan to bowl the last over of the day...
Switches to around the wicket and serves a length ball outside off, holding its line, Amla allows it through to the keeper.
Angling in a length ball around off, Elgar helps it through mid-wicket for a single.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
A little ahead of a fuller length, outside off, Hashim drives it through covers for a single.
Around off on a length, Amla punches from the back foot to covers.
Good length delivery outside off, left alone.
Mustafizur Rahman is brought back into the attack.
Drops it short on off, punched off the back foot towards the cover fielder.
Around middle and leg, skidding in a touch, Dean blocks it out well.
Quicker one outside off, left alone without much fuss.
Flatter on the stumps, defended down into the ground.
Oh that was close! The ball skids a bit off the surface as Elgar looks to defend but gets an inside edge as the ball rolls back on the stumps before Elgar stops it with his left boot.
Quicker through the air around off, defended off the front foot.
On a good length and around off, Amla taps it away towards the off side.
Back of a length outside off, Hashim hops back and punches it on the up but straight to the cover fielder.
Touch fuller and angling in, Amla comes forward and defends it with his bat and pad together.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Fuller and angling away, Dean Elgar slices the drive behind point for a single.
Starts off with a short ball outside off, punched to deep point for a single.
Second new ball has been taken by Bangladesh! Shafiul Islam to have a go with it first. Two slips in place...
Flatter and quicker through the air outside off, Dean comes forward before leaving it alone.
Slower through the air around off, Dean prods forward in defense.
Flatter and a bi t wider outside off, Elgar ignores.
Floats it up around off, Elgar takes a stride forward to keep it out.
Gets behind the line and defends it down.
Flatter through the air around off, punched off the back foot towards cover for a single.
Good length ball on middle and off, Elgar stands tall and defends.
On a length and on middle, defended down with a straight bat.
Dean Elgar lets the ball go outside his off stump.
A bit of width outside off, Amla cracks the cut square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Fuller and angling in on the pads, flicked towards fine leg for one.
Good length delivery on middle, punched towards the man at mid on.
FOUR! Easily done! Floats it up around middle and leg, Hashim Amla gets across and paddles it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Amla works it towards square leg. He wants the single but is sent back by Elgar.
Flatter on off, punched towards extra cover.
Elgar hits it through point and gets a single.
Tosses up outside off, spinning back in, Amla clips it through square leg for a single.
Tossed up around off, punched off the back foot towards mid on.
Another back foot defense by Elgar to end the over.
Bowls a length ball around off from around the wicket, Elgar defends it close to his front pad.
On a length outside off, Amla stands tall and punches it square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
A firm front foot drive by Amla but he finds the cover fielder.

Length delivery outside off, Amla sticks back and decides to play it late. Does well to steer it through backward point and Taskin in the deep boots it out near the fence at the last moment. Saves two.
Full and on middle, knocked down to long on for one.
A hint of spin away from the left-hander, around off, Elgar pushes inside the line and misses.
Flicks a full ball off his front foot, finds mid-wicket this time.
Angling away from the batsman, Elgar dabs it towards backward point and looks for a run. Not there.
Spinning down towards leg, Amla gets back and helps it through the gap at mid-wicket for one.
Fullish and on off, Amla uses his wrists to flick but finds the short mid-wicket fielder.
Angling into the batsman from wide of the crease, it's on a length around off and Elgar has to defend it. Does so solidly.
On a length and outside off, no real pace or movement, an easy leave for Dean.
Switches to around the wicket and angles in a length ball on off, Elgar defends it watchfully.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Fuller in length on off, Elgar is on the front foot in defense.
Full and angling into the batsman, Amla helps it off his pads to backward square leg for a single.

Second new ball is available now but not taken by Bangladesh. However, there is a bowling change. Shafiul Islam returns. A strange call not to opt for the new cherry immediately, maybe Rahim wants his bowler to settle into some rhythm first. No close-in fielders for Amla as Islam speeds in...
Played to the point region by the batsman. No run.
Fuller in length on middle, calmly worked in the gap on the leg side for one.

SIX! Reaches his 36th Test fifty in style! Mehedi tosses it up in the air and lands it around middle, Amla clears his front leg and lofts it nonchalantly over the bowler's head for a biggie. Has looked in sublime touch.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Walks down the track and wrists it towards short mid-wicket.
Flatter off spinner on off, Amla leans forward to defend but it takes the inside edge and rolls towards mid-wicket.
A low full toss on off, Elgar drives but fails to find the gap at covers.
Full flighted ball on off, Dean strides forward and jams it down.
Gets forward to a full ball and knocks it down to long on for a run.
Loopy and around off, Amla tries to flick but it takes the leading half of the bat and rolls to mid off.
Mid on drops back.
Lunges and works a full ball through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched from the crease to covers.
Sliding down the leg side, it's eased in front of square leg for a single.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. No run.
Leans forward to a full ball and defends it watchfully.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and on middle, quicker through the air, Amla knocks it down to long on for one.
Gets on the front foot and blocks it safely.
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.

DROPPED AND FOUR! Full floated ball on middle, Amla packs a punch, drills it straight back, it's uppish and hits Sabbir on his right hand. He fails to grab it and the ball ricochets down the ground for a boundary.
FOUR! Awful delivery, a full toss on off, Amla latches onto it and smashes it over mid-wicket. A poor attempt in the deep by the fielder facilitated the boundary.
A long hop on off, it's pulled past the diving mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Flatter ball on off, punched from the back foot to mid off.
Full in length and outside off, a comfortable drive down the ground to long off for a single.
Lunges and blocks it safely to the leg side.
Loopy and around off, Elgar presses forward and defends it back.
Strides forward and works it with the spin through mid-wicket for a single.

Miscommunication but no harm done this time. Tossed up ball on off, Amla plays it with the spin to square leg and Elgar comes running down the track in search of a run. He is sent back quickly and makes it home before the throw comes to the bowler. Nervy moment!
Flighted full ball outside off, 80.1 kph, Amla gets forward and across in defense.
Too full and outside off, Elgar digs it out square of the wicket on the off side. Straight to point.
Short and outside off, cut through cover-point for one.
Fullish on off, pushed to covers.
Flighted and full on off, Amla drives off the front foot to covers. Sabbir has bowled superbly so far.
Loopy leg spinner landing on middle, Amla sticks back inside the crease in defense.
Turning down the leg side, Elgar fails to flick and it goes off his pads to short fine leg. They cross and it's given as a leg bye.
Amla has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Mistimed shot! Tossed up ball around off, Amla swings his bat firmly across the line, maybe attempting to go over mid-wicket but it turns to grab the inside half of the bat. It runs towards square leg where the fielder makes a fine stop.
A loopy off spinner on off, Amla defends it off his front foot.
Fuller and flatter on the pads, it's flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted and full around middle, Elgar takes a stride forward and pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Shortish and outside off, hit from the back foot through backward point for a single.
Mehedi Hasan to bowl...

Drinks break. Easy going for Proteas! The Bangla bowlers haven't caused any trouble so far and are bowling without much intent. Another partnership is blossoming for the home team and they are looking set for a big first innings total.
Slower one on middle and leg, Dean Elgar helps it towards mid-wicket for nothing.
Floats it up on off, jammed out past cover for another single.
Tosses it up on middle, clipped towards square leg for an easy single.
Gets across a touch and works it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on off, defended by coming forward.
Bowls a leg spinner around off, turning back in, Elgar punches it back to the bowler.
Sabbir Rahman is brought into the attack now.
Short stuff from Ahmed, but no real pace behind it to trouble Amla. He sits under it.
Fuller ball in the line of the stumps, driven towards mid on.
Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

On a length and outside off, Elgar goes after it. Gets a bottom edge which goes on the bounce to the keeper. Taskin Ahmed is given a friendly warning by the umpire as he was seen landing near the danger area.
Bangs in a short ball on middle, Elgar gets out of the fiery line immediately.
Fuller delivery, angling in on the pads, Amla flicks it behind square on the leg side for a single. Brings up the 50-run stand as well! Another good one for the hosts.
Beaten! And it has happened after a really long time! Hasan pitches it around off, draws Elgar forward and then turns away to beat the outside edge.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Loopy ball outside off, eased down to long off for a single.
A dipping full toss on middle  and leg, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Goes back to this flatter ball and works it with soft hands towards mid-wicket.
Spinning a long way down the leg side, tucked towards square leg.
Length ball, sprayed on the pads, Elgar pats it into the leg side.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.
Gets across to this back of a length ball and knocks it towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length outside off, tapped towards point for a quick single.
Good length ball on off, Hashim isn't playing at those.
Short of a good length delivery, Amla adjusts for the low bounce and defends.
Slower through the air, outside off, Dean makes an easy leave.
Elgar has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Short and outside off, punched towards sweeper cover for a single.
This one is spinning down leg, Amla moves inside the line to leave it alone.
Goes back and stabs it down.
Turns it with the spin towards square leg.

NOT OUT! Elgar is safely in. Amla works one down to fine leg and calls through for a single. A throw comes in from the deep and Liton Das takes the bails off. They all appeal and it's taken upstairs. Replays show Elgar grounded his  bat in time.
A run out appeal against Elgar is taken upstairs...
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
A bit short and angling in, Hashim looks to tuck it away but it goes off the thigh pad down to fine leg. Two leg byes taken.
FOUR! Easy pickings, that! Fuller in length and angling in, Amla flicks it through mid-wicket. He's timed it so well that he doesn't even bother running after that one.
Good length delivery outside off, Amla shoulders his arms to that one.
Leg bye! Good length delivery on middle and leg, Elgar misses his flick as the ball goes off the pads and rolls towards square leg. A leg bye taken.
Low full toss, Elgar flicks it it towards Tamim at mid-wicket who parries it towards mid on. A single taken.
Elgar goes back and works it with the spin towards mid-wicket.
Drops it short on middle, punched towards the man at silly mid off.
Darted on leg, whipped through mid-wicket for a single.

In the air... safe! Hasan gives it a decent flight, it dips in, Amla comes dancing down the track. He takes it on the full and flicks it towards Mahmudullah at mid-wicket. Luckily for Amla, it falls short of him.
Floated on the stumps, worked towards mid-wicket.
Taps it towards cover and crosses over to keep strike.
Slower bumper on middle, takes eternity to come to Amla. The batsman gives it his all to pull only to get beaten due to the lack of pace.
Short and bowled well outside off, Amla tries to cut it hard but gets it off the bottom half and it goes on the bounce to the gully fielder who makes a diving stop.
Angles it in from around off, Amla presents a tight defense.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Amla drops his wrists to leave it alone.
Comes steaming in from over the wicket and drops it on a length, angling in. Amla leans forward and turns it towards mid-wicket.
Taskin Ahmed is back into the attack.
Flatter one outside off, the batsman leaves it alone.
Slower one around middle, DE camps back and knocks it towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Down the track and boom! Sees the flight, decides to advance down the track. He does so and gives it a whack over mid-wicket. The ball bounces before crossing the ropes.
This one skids a bit off the deck, Elgar goes back and pats it towards mid-wicket.
Drifting in on middle and off, Dean blocks.
Short, flat and served outside off, cracked towards sweeper cover for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Dean rises a touch and defends it with a full face of the bat.

Uppish! Fuller ball and it seemed to have gripped off the surface. Elgar looks to drive but ends up chipping it back to Rahman, who in his followthrough bends low but it falls short of him. The ball hits his left boot and parries further away on the off side.
Touch short on middle, tucked through mid-wicket for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Hashim doesn't bother going after it.
Once again tries to repeat the previous shot but this time the fielder from second slip dives to his left to stop that one.
FOUR! Deft is what you call it! Another off cutter from Mustafizur, angling away. What does Amla do? He leans forward just a touch, opens the bat face and gets it past second slip for a boundary.
Makes a bit of room but pushes it straight to mid off.
Floats it up outside off, driven towards the extra cover fielder. There is a slight fumble but they don't run.
Slider, sneaking in but Elgar does well to keep it out.
Flatter one on the stumps, defended by covering the line.
Tossed up ball around off, Amla gets down and paddles it fine down the leg side. Gets three runs for doing so.
Spinning back in from outside off, Amla misses his attempted flick shot and wears it on the pads.
Off cutter from the Fizz, Elgar lunges ahead and defends it down.
Pitched right up there, driven on the up but finds the mid on fielder.
Wide! Slower ball but way, way outside off, Dean watches it go through to the keeper.
On a fuller length and outside off, shouldered arms to.
Ahead of a length, outside off, defended off the front foot.
Mustafizur sticks to fuller length, it's met with a straight bat. The ball rolls towards mid on.
Fuller on the stumps, driven towards the fielder at mid on.
Beaten! Quicker through the air, outside off, Amla goes back to cut but it stays really low to beat the outside edge of his bat.
Tossed up outside off, driven towards long off for a single.
Darted on middle and leg, pushed towards mid on.
Flatter on the stumps, defended gently.
Coming in from around off, Elgar blocks.
Around middle and off, defended off the back foot.

A loud, loud shout for a caught behind, not given! It's the off cutter from Rahman this time, Amla is completely foxed by it. The ball goes off something to the keeper and they put in an appeal. The umpire, however, stays put. Rahim thinks about the review but then decides against it. Replays show it beat the outside edge and then brushed the back pad. No bat involved and the Hawk Eye shows, it is pitching outside leg.
Wider on off, Hashim shoulders his arms to that one.
Angling away on a fuller length, Amla doesn't go after it.

FOUR! This time he beats mid off! Rahman slants it away on a fuller length, it was pretty much in the zone for Amla who offers a straight blade to it. Races away to the fence for a boundary. Top class!
Gets across and once again finds the fielder at mid off.
Starts off with a fuller ball from over the wicket, Amla plays a punchy drive to mid off.
Mustafizur Rahman is back into the attack.
Floated delivery outside off, Dean leans forward and defends it down.
Quicker one, sliding in, flicked through square leg for a single.
Shimmies down the track and works it towards mid on for nothing.
Gets behind the line is Amla and blocks it out.
Floats it up around off, Amla comes forward to defend but the ball takes the inside edge and rolls towards square leg.
Slider around leg, worked away towards square leg for one.
Fuller and angling in on middle, flicked through mid-wicket by Elgar to retain strike.
Good length ball on middle, wristed towards mid on for a single.
Fuller again, tailing back in a touch, Elgar drags it off the inner half to deep square leg for a single.
Once again keeps it in the corridor outside off, Dean Elgar makes an easy leave. It goes on the bounce to the keeper.
Pretty harmless delivery, fuller ball outside off, left alone.
Good length delivery, close to the off stump, Elgar blocks it down on the ground.
Flighted delivery outside off, defended off the front foot and into the ground.
Flatter and angling in on middle and leg, Elgar stays back and flicks it through square leg for one.
Gives it a bit more air, lands it full on off, a solid front foot defense by Elgar.
Pitches it around off, it turns in as Amla goes back to clip it past short leg for a single.
Slider around off, it stays a bit low as well. Dean adjusts well and punches it towards cover for a single.
Tossed up ball outside off, driven towards the man at cover.
Mehedi Hasan will bowl from the other end.
Angles in a full ball just outside off, Amla drives it off his front foot to mid off.
Lands it on a length and outside off, staying a bit low, Amla moves across the stumps, keeps his eyes on the ball and defends it watchfully to covers.
Pitches it full and outside off, Amla keeps his weight on the back leg and defends it to covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Amla is away in style! A wide half-volley outside off, Hashim with his back and across movement does well to squeeze it out through point for a boundary. Lovely hands.
Good length delivery outside off, Amla plays it down from the crease to the off side.

We're back for the final session of play. The players stroll out to the centre. Bangladesh will be hoping for a few more wickets before stumps today but for that they have to bowl a lot better. On the other hand, the aim for the current batting pair will be to see off this session without any casualty. Shafiul Islam to bowl first up...
...Day 1, third session...

Another session dominated by South Africa, however, Bangladesh will be relieved to have broken the opening partnership. Aiden Markram batted superbly all morning and afternoon but was unfortunate to get dismissed three short of his maiden Test hundred. Dean Elgar, who at this moment will be kicking himself for that miscommunication which cost the debutant his wicket, has notched up his century and is looking settled to get a daddy hundred here. The Asian side has looked clueless with the ball so far and would hope to up their performance post tea. Do join us in a short while for more action.
Flighted and on off, defended off the front foot. Tea on day 1!
Tossed up ball outside off, tapped to point.

Century number 9 for Dean Elgar in Tests! He uses his feet to come down the track and chips it over mid off for a couple of runs. This is his fourth ton this year. Wonderful innings by him, although the celebration is a quiet one. Still feeling bad for Markram, we all are.
Gets on the front foot and drives it back.
Hashim Amla strides out next.

OUT! Dear me, Markram is run out on 97! He is dejected on his way back to the pavilion. Elgar too is disappointed and is down on his haunches. Aiden wanted his partner to get to the century and hence was backing up too much. Once Elgar played it towards point and took a head start, Markram came rushing down seeing that. But Dean stuttered after watching the point fielder attacking the ball. He tried sending him back but Markram was too much down the track. Had no hope of returning and meanwhile the ball was parried to the bowler who took the bails off. An unfortunate end to a promising knock by the debutant. Bangladesh finally have a breakthrough out of nowhere.
Fetches a full ball from outside off and slogs it across the line. Finds Taskin (who's back on field) at mid-wicket.
Goes on the back foot and slaps it to sweeper cover for one. On 99 now!
Another forward push by Dean but the cover fielder makes a diving half stop.
Full and flighted outside off, driven to covers.
FOUR! Fancy footwork by Elgar. Dances down to the pitch of the delivery (which is on middle) and launches it over long on for a biggie. Moves to 98!
A low full toss on middle, flicked on the leg side but straight to mid-wicket.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Markram cuts it through point for one.
Mahmudullah is brought back into the attack.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
A touch short and on middle, pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Slips it down the leg side. Markram fails to flick.
Rocks back to a short ball and smashes it through point for a couple.
It's on the pads of the batsman, worked with ease in the gap on the leg side for one.
Straighter in line, worked through mid-wicket for a single.

Missing leg! Flighted ball landing on middle, turning in, Elgar kneels to sweep but misses and is hit on the pads. They appeal but nothing from the umpire. Bangladesh take the DRS. The reviews roll out and it shows that the impact is within line but it's spinning too much and would have missed the leg stump. Bangladesh lose a review.
DRS time! With nothing happening, Bangladesh have decided to review this decision against Dean Elgar.
Shortish and outside off, cut through point for a single.
Skidding down the leg side, Elgar eases it to fine leg for three runs.
Stays back and punches it to long off for a single.
FOUR! Wow. Mominul drags his length short, around middle, Markram uses the depth of the crease, has a lot of time to play his shot and smashes it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Quicker one on middle, helped behind square leg for an easy single.
Shortish and outside off, hit back to the bowler from the crease. Taskin takes his cap and immediately goes off the field. Taijul Islam is the substitute.
Taskin is holding the hamstring of his left leg. Hoping nothing serious.
Fuller length ball angling into the batsman, on middle, Elgar closes the face of the bat and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish in length and around off, Elgar tries to run it down to third man but Mehedi Hasan dives from gully to make an outstanding stop.
Harmless delivery, short and wide outside off, Elgar allows it through to Liton Das.
Full and outside off, Markram gets forward and drives it through covers for a single.
Starts this spell with a back of a length ball outside off, Elgar goes back and punches it through cover-point for a single.
Taskin Ahmed has a task in hand to break this partnership as he returns in the attack.
Quietly nudges it through mid on for yet another single in the over.
Short and wide outside off, forced to sweeper cover for a single.
Tossed up ball on off, eased down to long on for a run.
Slower one, spinning in, Elgar works it with the spin through mid-wicket for a couple.
Leans forward to a full ball and flicks it to mid-wicket again.
Flatter, shorter and spinning back in from outside off, Elgar goes back and punches it to mid-wicket.
Mominul Haque to have a go with the ball.
Shortish and outside off, Elgar goes deep inside the crease and punches it through mid off for a single.
Sliding down the leg side, worked behind square leg for a single.
Markram has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flighted one on middle, flicked across the line but straight towards deep wide mid on. A single taken.
Slower one, full and on middle, Elgar defends it off his front foot.
Flatter ball on middle, defended on the leg side.

EDGY FOUR! Rahman switches to around the wicket and angles in a length ball around off, it straightens a touch after landing and squares up the batsman in defense. It catches the outside edge and speeds past the slip cordon for a boundary at third man. No luck for Bangladesh.
Good length delivery angling away from the batsman, 134 kph, Aiden stays back and pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Fuller and outside off, driven to covers.
FOUR! Poor delivery, a full toss wide outside off, Markram throws his bat at it and bottom edges it past the diving keeper and first slip fielder for a boundary.
Good shot for none. A front foot drive by Aiden, well-timed but straight to mid off.
Fuller length ball on middle and leg, Markram pushes it off his pads to mid on.
Forces a full ball past the silly mid on fielder for a single.
Floated one on middle, worked towards square leg.
Markram has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Slower full ball around leg, tickled towards the backward square leg fielder.
Flighted and on middle, turned to mid-wicket.
Helps it off his pads through the gap on the leg side for a couple of runs.
Elgar has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Outside off on a length, left alone.

FOUR! Beautiful! Outstanding shot, that. A juicy half-volley outside off, Elgar picks the length very early, leans into the drive and creams it through the gap between mid off and extra cover. 150 up for South Africa. Last time South Africa managed this kind of a start, Graeme Smith was still playing, way back in 2010 in Dubai.
Angles in a full ball on off, Dean flicks it on the leg side but once again finds the same mid-wicket fielder.
On a length and outside off, Elgar tries driving through the line but it comes off the inner portion of the bat and rolls to mid-wicket.
Too full in length on off, Elgar digs it out towards mid on.
Leans forward to a full ball and defends it solidly.
Floated one on middle, pushed back towards the bowler off the front foot.
Flat again, outside off, it's punched down to long off for a run.
A touch flatter and shorter around leg, Elgar fails to work it around and is hit on the pads. They put in an unsuccessful appeal.
Loopy ball on off, Elgar gets forward in defense.
Flighted ball on middle, Elgar defends it off his back foot.
Too full in length and way wide outside off, an easy leave.
Bowls it on a driving length outside off, Aiden is not tempted by the prospect of playing a cover drive.
Drops it on a length and outside off, Dean stays back and steers it through point for a single.
Hits the yorker mark around off, Elgar keeps his eyes on the ball and digs it out to point.
On a length and around leg, calmly worked through the mid-wicket area for a single.
Angling away from the batsman outside off, it's allowed through to the keeper.
Mustafizur Rahman is back into the attack. A slip and gully in place...

Drinks time. There hasn't been much change in Bangladesh's fortune. They continue to work hard but without any success. Both the South African openers have settled in and are looking good for a big one. Ominous signs.
Flighted full ball outside off, defended off the front foot to the off side.
Slider around off, skidding through, Markram tries defending with a lunge but it takes the outside edge and rolls towards point. A single taken.
Tossed up ball on middle, defended with the spin to mid-wicket.
Fuller and on middle, quicker through the air, pushed down towards mid on.
Floated off spinner on middle, Markram gets forward and defends it from the inner half of the bat.
Lovely flight, slows this one in the air and lands it full around off, 83 kph, Elgar drives it towards cover-point for a single.
Fullish and angling in around off, it's pushed back with a straight bat.
Full and sliding down the leg side, Dean Elgar flicks it off his pads to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Width on offer outside off, some visible extra bounce, Aiden cuts it square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Staying a bit low outside off, Dean pushes it in front of point and his partner calls him through for a quick single.
Full and outside off, Elgar drives it off his front foot to mid off.
Short and outside off, Aiden Markram camps back and smacks it through covers. It races through and Taskin Ahmed in the deep makes a tumbling stop near the fence. Saves a run for his side.

SIX! Oh, that's gone all the way. Flighted full ball on middle, Elgar gets down on one knee and slogs it over mid-wicket. Never looked like he is trying to hit it too hard, a bit of top edge there as well but still it sails all the way into the stand at square leg.
Too full in length and on off, Elgar drives it towards the cover fielder.
Slower through the air, a touch short around off, Elgar gets back and taps it down to silly point.
Flighted and on middle, from around the wicket, Elgar gets forward and defends it to the leg side.
Tossed up ball outside off, Markram plays it late and guides it wide of backward point for a run.
Markram has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Switches to around the wicket for the southpaw and bowls a length delivery wide outside off, 127.9 kph, Elgar leaves it. Shafiul is bowling at a really gentle pace, his seam position is also not landing upright and as a result, the ball ain't doing anything.
Short and wide outside off, it's cracked off the back foot through cover-point for a run.
Another leave outside the off stump by the debutant.
Length delivery in the channel outside off, left alone.

Nearly drags it on! Shafiul bowls it on a length and wide outside off, Markram chases it away from his body, tries to slap it square of the wicket on the off side but gets a bottom edge. It goes on one drop to the keeper who dives to his left to make a one-handed stop.
A touch short in length outside off, Dean punches it from the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
Extra air on this delivery, full and around off, Markram clips it across the line and another excellent piece of fielding by Mahmudullah coming to his left from mid-wicket.
Gets forward to a full ball and pushes it to silly mid on.
Flicks it with the spin to mid-wicket where Mahmudullah makes a diving stop.
Quicker one on middle, blocked towards short mid-wicket.
Slower through the air but on the shorter side outside off, Aiden cuts it off his back foot to point.
Flighted off spinner on off, defended off the front foot to short mid-wicket.
A gentle delivery in the corridor of uncertainty, 124.7 kph, not threatening enough, Elgar has another comfortable leave.
Good length ball just outside off, Elgar strokes it from the back foot to covers.
Lands it on a length outside off, holding its line, Elgar allows it through to the keeper.
Fullish and around off, Dean drives it back to the bowler.
Good length ball on off, punched off the back foot to covers.
Bowls a length delivery outside off, probably a hint of reverse swing there, Elgar watches it very closely before making the leave.
Full floated on off, Aiden is forward in defense this time.
Flatter and on middle, Markram defends it off his back foot.
Sliding into the batsman from around off, Elgar works it in front of square leg for a single.
Fires in a fuller ball on middle, Aiden flicks it firmly through wide mid on for a single.
Tossed up ball outside off, defended off the front foot.
Markram has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Angles in a length ball on off, Elgar stays back and plays across the line. Finds the mid-wicket fielder.
In the channel outside off, not rising much off the deck, Elgar leaves it alone.
Fullish and outside off from around the wicket, Elgar plays a drive off his front foot but finds mid off.
A touch short on off, punched from the back foot to covers again.
Outside off on a length, Elgar plays a flowing cover drive but finds the fielder.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Shafiul Islam is back into the attack. A slip and gully in place. Two men back on the leg side.
FOUR! Once again brilliant footwork shown by the debutant. He is down the track in a flash and whips it through mid-wicket. There is a fielder in the deep but he is a mere spectator.
As a result of the last shot, the bowler goes short. Markram anticipates it well, uses the depth of the crease and plays the square cut. Finds point.
FOUR! Shot! Growing in confidence, Markram. Flighted full ball just around off, spinning in a touch, Aiden lines himself and powers it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Gets forward to a full ball again and defends it to the off side.
Walks down the track and pushes a full ball back towards the bowler.
A loopy off spinner outside off, Aiden defends it off his front foot.
A slower one this time by Taskin, Elgar reads it well and blocks.
Full and angling in around middle, Dean defends it off the front foot to mid on.
Change of angle from the bowler. Runs in from around the wicket and hurls a good length delivery outside off, Elgar allows it through.
FOUR! A wayward bouncer and it's put away. Down the leg side, Elgar pulls it through backward square leg and beats the fine leg fielder to the fence.
The short pitched ball is followed with a fuller one outside off, Elgar lunges and defends it to mid off.
Short in length around middle and off, Elgar fails to time his attempted pull shot. Goes off the bottom half to the leg side. Lack of speed there resulted in an untimed shot.
Slightly slower this time, full and outside off, 86 kph, Aiden is on the front foot as he blocks it to the off side.
Flighted and on middle, 88 kph, pushed down towards mid on.
Stays back and plays it with the spin to short leg.
Tossed up ball outside off, left alone.
Slower through the air, full and turning in a bit, Aiden presses forward in defense.
Loopy and full outside off, driven wide of mid off for a quick single.
Markram has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Oohhhh...this one stays low again. Alarming signs already, more for Bangladesh who will have to bat last on this pitch. Outside off, Markram does well to keep it out albeit off the bottom edge of the bat. Rolls towards the slip cordon.

Huge shout for a caught behind! Not given. Bangladesh have the option to take the DRS but they opt against it. Coming back to the delivery - It's on back of a length around middle and leg, staying low, Markram fails to middle his pull shot. It goes behind to the keeper who catches and appeals. The umpire remains unmoved and the replays show that it came of Aiden's thigh pad. Good call.
Angling into the batsman, too straight in line, Aiden keeps it out towards mid on again.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Full length delivery around off, Markram drives it off his front foot to mid on.
Elgar has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up ball on off, once again Elgar finds the cover fielder with his front foot drive.
Quicker and fuller on off, defended with an angled bat to point.
Strides forward and drives it straight to the cover fielder.
This one skids back in from around off, Elgar stays back and punches it to the off side.
Flighted full ball on off, Elgar pushes it off his front foot to short cover. Not much turn off the pitch
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Quite strong down the ground, Aiden. Another overpitched ball is met with a straight bat by Markram. Timing is brilliant and it speeds through mid on for a glorious boundary.
In the zone outside off, Markram is not overawed by the moment, maintains his composure and lets it through to the keeper.

Fifty on debut for Aiden Markram, ninth South African opener to achieve that on debut. A delightful square drive by him to a full ball. It's fielded in the deep by the third man fielder and Aiden takes a couple of runs in the meantime. Satisfying moment for him, has worked hard in the domestic cricket and is now shining on the international platform.
FOUR! Nice shot! An overpitched delivery on off, Markram gets on the front foot and drives it with nice timing past mid off for a boundary. He is enjoying a good debut, so far, one away from a fifty.
Short mid-wicket in place.
Angling in a length ball on off, Markram solidly defends it back from the crease.
Another sharp delivery, 91.7 kph, flatter and angling in, Aiden eases it down to mid on for a single.
Quicker one, around middle and off, defended off the back foot.
Flatter and a touch shorter outside off, Elgar punches it wide of backward point and collects a quick single again.
Spinning back into the batsman from around off, Markram quietly nudges it wide of backward square leg for a quick single. 100 up for South Africa!
Aiden has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flighted full ball around off, turning in, Markram presses forward and defends it off the inner half of the bat to square leg.
Mehedi Hasan to bowl from the other end. A slip and short leg in place.
This one is served around leg, staying a touch low, Elgar keeps his eyes on the ball and defends it to the off side.
This one is sprayed wide outside off, an easy leave for Elgar.
On a length and just outside off, Elgar punches from the back foot towards cover-point.
Gets closer to the off stump this time, fuller in length, Elgar decides to keep it out from the back foot. Should have been forward there.
Angling away from the southpaw, on a length and leaving the batsman, Elgar shoulders arms.
Begins the session with a length ball just around off, Dean goes on the back foot and punches it towards mid on.

Out come the players back on the field. The sun continues to shine brightly in Potchefstroom and it's shining more on South Africa at the moment. Bangladesh are put under early pressure and will need wickets quickly to gain some confidence. Taskin  Ahmed to start proceedings...
...Day 1, second session...

Bangladesh have been made to toil hard under the sun. Their bowlers lacked venom and have looked rather pedestrian. Rahim brought Mehedi Hasan early into the attack but even he hasn't got much of a purchase. The tourists need to come up with a certain plan after the break if they are to restrict the hosts. Join us in a short while for the post-lunch session...

A pretty much satisfactory session for South Africa! They have begun their home season in a classic manner, with 99 on the board without a loss of any wicket. On a dry pitch, sent in to bat, the Protea openers looked a bit tentative at the start but once they settled in, it was all too easy for them. Aiden Markram has made the most of the opportunity so far and would be looking to convert this start. Elgar on the other hand has looked at his usual best and he too would be eyeing a big one under his belt.
Good length delivery on middle, Aiden Markram covers the line and defends it down. LUNCH ON DAY 1!
Bowls a short ball on middle and leg, Elgar tucks it besides the pitch and crosses over for a quick single.
Shortish and it comes slowly off the deck, Aiden is early into the pull as he drags it off the inner half behind square on the leg side for a single.
Slips one down the leg side, Aiden looks to help it away but fails to do so.

FOUR! Uppish but he hits it in the gap! Rahman goes full, offers a bit of width and that's enough for Markram to unleash. He bends his back knee and drives it uppishly over covers for a boundary. Excellent shot!
From around the wicket, Rahman angles it in on middle, worked towards mid-wicket.
Elgar presses forward and unfurls a drive which goes straight to the cover fielder.
Goes around the wicket this time, keeps it on middle, driven through mid on for a single.
Hasan is happy to toss it up outside off, once again it's defended off the front foot.
Loops it up on off, Aiden lunges forward to keep it out.
On middle and off, blocked into the ground.
Floated delivery outside off, defended gently off the front foot.
Short and outside off, Dean drops his wrists to let the sail over him to Das behind.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched through cover-point and comes back for a couple.
Bangs in a short ball on middle, Elgar ducks under it.
Short of a length outside off, dabbed behind point for a single.

Excellent fielding from Rahim! Slightly overpitched on middle, Elgar drives it down the ground. Seemed like a boundary but Rahim from mid on gives it a chase and dives to pull the ball back in play. Saves a run for his side.
Good length delivery outside off, defended towards the cover fielder.

Chance of a run out! A bit of confusion but no harm done. Flighted delivery on off, Markram drives it towards mid off. Waits for a bit and then sets off. Is nearly halfway down the track before Elgar sends him back. He turns around in time and makes it in, in time. He was running on the pitch and hence umpire Bruce Oxenford gives him a friendly warning.
Fuller on off, jammed out towards mid off.

That's fifty for Dean Elgar, his 9th in Tests! A good solid knock from him. Loopy ball outside off, eased down to long off for a single. Gets a round of applause from his mates. He has been in outstanding form of late and is making most of it.
Slider around middle, kept out off the back foot.
Tossed up around off, defended towards the man at silly point.
Around middle and off, punched down to long on for a single.
Once again Elgar taps it down off the front foot towards the off side.
On a length and on the off stump, Elgar stays put in the crease and defends it towards cover.
On the pads, flicked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Back of a length delivery, slanting away, dabbed in front of point.
Good length delivery on middle, Markram keeps his bat in front of pads to keep it out.
Length delivery outside off, crunched through covers for a couple.
Mustafizur Rahman is brought back again.
Round-arm action, darts it on middle and leg, worked towards mid on for nothing.
Fuller on off, driven back to the bowler.
Stands tall to this flatter ball and punches it down to long on for a single.
Slides it down the leg side, Elgar prods ahead and nudges it fine down the leg side. Runs three and is on 49 now.
Flighted ball on off, Dean makes room and drives it towards short extra cover.
Comes from around the wicket and tosses it up outside off, Elgar defends it in front of silly point.
Spin from both ends as Mehedi Hasan is back on. A silly point and a slip given to him...
Drops it short, it's outside off, Markram goes back and punches it towards sweeper cover for a couple.
Darts it full on middle, wristed behind square on the leg side for one.
Tossed up around off, turning in a bit, worked with the angle down to long on for a single.
Drifting in on middle, clipped past the man at mid-wicket for a single.
Loops it up on off, defended nicely by taking a stride forward.
Slider around middle and off, Elgar pushes it away from the body and hence gets an inside edge on the pads.
Mahmudullah is brought into the attack. He is back into the side after a while. Can he draw first blood?
Veering on the pads again, clipped down to deep square leg for a single.
Gets forward to a full length delivery and pushes it with a straight bat to mid on. Looks for the single which is certainly not on.
Pitches it really full outside off, bunted towards the mid off fielder.
Fuller on off again, Dean Elgar comes forward and defends it down gently.
Good length delivery outside off, Elgar takes his bottom hand off as he still manages to push it into the cover region.
Fuller in length on off, Elgar leans forward and drives it towards mid off.
Mustafizur Rahman is back into the attack.
A little bit of movement back into the right-hander from outside off, Markram blocks from the back foot to end the over.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Good length delivery on off, punched off the back foot to covers.
Pitches it full and outside off, Aiden drives it off his front foot to mid off.

JUST SHORT! First real opportunity this morning for Bangladesh but it has not carried to the point fielder. Back of a length delivery outside off, Markram attempts to punch it off his back foot through covers but slices it off the outer half of the bat to point. Mustafizur Rahman (don't know why he is there) dives forward but it falls inches short of his outstretched hands. Taskin has a wry smile on his face.
Fuller length ball on middle, it's flicked off the pads on the leg side but straight towards mid-wicket.
Walks across a touch and flicks it towards mid-wicket for nothing.
On a length around middle and off, pushed back to the bowler off the back foot.
Back of a length outside off, punched to deep cover for a single.
Fuller delivery on off, driven towards the mid off fielder who misfields and concedes a single.
FOUR! Superbly done! Fuller and veering in on the pads, Elgar gets across and works it wide of mid on to pick up a boundary.
Fuller and angling in, Elgar looks to defend but inside edges it on the pads. Seems to be in some pain.
Good length delivery on off, punched off the back foot.

FOUR! Beautiful shot! Taskin Ahmed sprays this one on the pads, Markram leans forward, keeps his head still and nails the flick through mid-wicket. The timing was spot on too. This is also the highest opening wicket stand for the hosts this year.
On a fuller length around off, Aiden comes across a bit and then lifts his bat to leave it alone in the end.
Length delivery arrowing in on off, stabbed off the back foot towards cover.
On the sixth stump line, Aiden doesn't have anything to offer.
Length ball outside off, Markram lifts his bat to make an easy leave.
Back of a length delivery outside off, dabbed away towards the gully fielder.
Too straight again from Islam, it's on the pads. Dean flicks it to deep square leg for a brace.
Hits the deck hard, it holds its line as Dean Elgar hangs his bat out in defense. It wasn't far away from taking the outside edge.
A touch too full on off, driven off the front foot towards mid on.
Good stop! Fuller and a bit too straight from Islam. Elgar lunges ahead and flicks it towards mid-wicket where Sabbir Rahman dives full length to his right to stop some runs.
Short of a length delivery outside off, slapped square of the wicket on the off side for a single.

Drinks are on the field. It's been a good first hour for South Africa. They have scored above 50 and it has taken them 16 innings to get a partnership going at the top. Debutant Markram was nervy at the start but has done well once he got his eye in. Elgar is looking in fine touch too. Bangladesh started off well but leaked too many runs as the game progressed. Tried spin early as well but to no avail. Need to up their game or else a long day on the field beckons...
FOUR! Nicely done! Fuller in length and outside off, Dean Elgar leans across a bit, opens the bat face and glides it through second slip for a boundary. Second of the over!
Slants it away on a length around off, patted towards mid off.
FOUR! After bowling three good balls, Taskin errs! He bangs in a short ball, on the leg stump. No harm done as Elgar tucks it down towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
A bit fuller on middle and off, bunted back to the bowler.
A pacy length delivery, at 140 kph, Elgar doesn't feel for it.
Shortish outside off, pushed off the back foot towards point.
Fuller ball on the stumps, driven with a straight bat to mid on.
Good length outside off, covers the line to leave it alone.

FOUR! Inside edge and through! Brings up the 50-run partnership for the opening wicket for South Africa after 16 innings! They have been struggling to get going at the top, this should be a good sign for them. Cross-seam delivery on off, Markram goes hard at it. Gets a thick inside edge past the stumps to beat the dive of the keeper. It races away towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Back of a length on off, a punchy drive towards mid off.
FOUR! Scorching! A gentle half-volley, served on off, Aiden Markram's eyes lit up as he bashes it through extra cover for a boundary.
Lands it on a length, nipping back in a bit, Aiden is solid in defense.
Shafiul Islam is back in for another spell here.
A bit fuller on middle and leg, nudged wide of the man at mid-wicket to keep strike.
Short, wide and it's put away. Elgar rocks back and crunches it through covers and collects three for doing so.
Good length delivery on middle, worked towards mid on for a brisk single.
Fuller on middle and leg, flicked down to fine leg for a single.

Good length delivery on middle, Elgar comes forward to push it and does so with his bottom hand coming off. Rolls back to the bowler. Taskin is a bit lazy to get a hand to it as it goes through mid on. Two taken.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Elgar stands tall to defend it down.
Slows it a bit through the air, worked away past short leg for a single.
Markram stays back to this length ball and punches it down to long on to collect one.
Quicker one on middle and leg, Dean gets low to work it in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Gives it a bit more air, Markram takes it on the full and works it down to long on for a single.
Flat and bowled outside off, punched through cover for a single.
Drops it short and it turns away a bit, Elgar looks to cut but gets a bottom edge besides the pitch.
Ahmed goes full, goes straight and it's easily flicked through mid-wicket. A single picked up.
Taskin comes running in but just when he was about to deliver, he loses his mark. Goes back again near the run-up area...
Bangs in a short ball on middle, it kicks off the deck, Dean Elgar ducks quickly under it. A good take by Liton Das as well.
Taskin changes the angle, goes around the wicket, hurls it on a back of a length outside off. Pushed with a angled bat towards point.
Short of a good length delivery outside off, Elgar stays back and shows a straight bat.
Good length ball on middle and off, wristed into the on side.
Starts off with a fuller length delivery, from over the wicket, it's slanting away but doesn't tempt Elgar to go after it.
Taskin Ahmed is brought into the attack now. Two slips and a gully...
Goes back to his short ball and punches it towards long off for a single.
Slower through the air around off, Elgar blocks it out off the front foot.
Quicker one on middle and leg, nudged towards mid on.
Flatter through the air, defended off the back foot gently.
FOUR! Eased down the ground! Lovely looking shot, that! Hasan tosses it up on middle, it's dipping in as Elgar advances down the track to belt it past mid on for a boundary. No need to run for those.
Floats it up around middle and off, defended nicely by coming forward.
Fuller in length and outside off, Aiden shoulders his arms to that one.
Sprays it on the pads, glanced down to fine leg for a comfortable single.
Bowls a bumper but not much pace behind it, Elgar sits under it to let that loop over his head to the keeper.
Shorter in length on middle and leg, stabbed off the back foot towards the off side.
Back of a length delivery on middle and leg, worked towards mid-wicket.
Short and angling in on the body, fended by hopping in the crease. The ball rolls towards square leg for a single.
Flatter through the air outside off, defended off the back foot towards cover.
Misfield! Tossed up outside off, Elgar makes a bit of room and drives it straight back to the bowler who parries it to mid off. Rahim stationed there slips and that allows them to pick another one.
Flatter and drifting in on middle and leg, Elgar goes back quickly and defends it towards the on side.
Drops it on a length and it kicks a bit off the surface, Dean counters it off the back foot.
Slower through the air, landing it on off, defended by coming forward.

FOUR! Just a shimmy and it's gone to the fence! Elgar sees the flight, skips down the track, gets to the pitch of the delivery and eases it through mid off. Good timing as well. First one of the day for Elgar!
A solid back foot defense on this good length delivery to end the over.
That is a good delivery! Bangs in a short ball, angling in on middle and leg. Elgar gets in a tangle as he takes his eyes off the ball. Fends it awkwardly towards square leg for one.
A bit short and outside off, cut square of the wicket as the point fielder moves to his left to stop it.
Mustafizur hits the deck hard, gets a good amount of bounce as well. Dean is quick to duck under it.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Fuller and this one comes back in just a touch, really close to the off stump. Elgar makes a brave leave.
On middle and leg, worked away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy delivery, lands it full on off, driven towards cover.
Tossed up on off, dealt with a forward defensive push.
Gives it a nice flight and loops it up around off, it grips off the surface as Elgar with an angled bat plays it towards the point fielder.
Loops it up around off, Dean presses forward in defense.
Hasan from around the wicket bowls a flatter ball outside off, left alone by Elgar.
Rahim makes an early change here. He brings his spinner, Mehedi Hasan into the attack. A slip and a short leg in place.
Fullish delivery on off, bunted towards the cover fielder.
Good length ball on middle and off, defended by covering the line.

FOUR! Elegance personified! He'll remember this shot for a while, says Shaun Pollock on air. Rahman overpitches it by a margin, it's outside off. Markram leans ahead and caresses it off the meat of the bat. It blazes through covers for a boundary.
Length ball, moving away off the pitch, Markram points his bat upwards and lets it be.
Slants it away on a good length outside off, defended nicely by coming forward.

Rahman keeps it full on middle and leg, it's clipped towards Rahim at mid-wicket who is a bit sloppy as he allows the ball to burst through his fingers. It then rolls towards mid on which allows the batsmen to take a single.
A bit short and angling in, Aiden winds up for a pull shot but misses and wears it on the chest.
FOUR! Flicks it beautifully! Islam goes full but angles it down the leg side, Markram leans across and flicks it neatly. Gets it past Rahman at mid-wicket and picks up the first boundary of the day.
On a back of a length outside off, it's defended off the back foot.
Angles it in from around off, the batsman covers the sticks and offers a straight blade.
Good length delivery, holding its line as well, Aiden leaves it for the keeper.
Nicely bowled! Good stuff from Islam. He fires in a yorker at the base of off stump, Markram is quick to bring his bat down and dig it out.
Length delivery on middle, Elgar prods forward to block.
The debutant is off the mark! That should calm his nerves! A bit fuller on off, he lunges forward and pushes it tentatively towards cover for a quick single.
Pitches it on a length on off, AM gets behind and then lifts his bat to let it be.
Lures the debutant with a full ball on off, he resists and makes a leave.
Slants it away on a fuller length on off, Aiden lunges across and defends it down.

South Africa are off the mark! Rahman keeps it full and angles it in but is a bit too straight on this occasion. Elgar gets across a bit and clips it wide of mid on. The fielder gives it a chase and stops it just inside the rope. Three runs picked up.
Fuller and tailing back in a touch, Markram looks to drive but gets it off the inner half towards mid on. Islam starts off with a maiden too.
Short of a length delivery outside off, the batsman covers the line to keep it out towards cover.
Fuller and coming back in a touch, Markram lunges forward in defense.
On a back of a length, making Aiden play, he offers a straight bat.
Length delivery on off, good tight line. Markram makes an easy leave.
Comes running in from over the wicket, drops it on a good length on off, the debutant shoulders his arms.
Shafiul Islam to share the new ball.
A maiden to start off with for Rahman! Fuller in length and pitched outside off, Dean has got nothing to do with that one.
Touch fuller in the zone outside off, moves away which allows Elgar to leave it alone.
Easy leave again! Continues to keep it in the channel outside off.
Hurls it on a length outside off, Elgar leans ahead, watches it till the last moment before shouldering arms to that one.
On a length and shaping away once again, Dean stays back and makes another easy leave.
A bit of movement for Rahman straightaway! He starts off from over the wicket and keeps it on a fuller length and it moves away off the deck, Elgar leaves it alone.

It's time to get underway. Aiden Markram, the debutant walk out to the centre along with Dean Elgar. Bright and sunny conditions at the moment. Mustafizur Rahman to kick off the proceedings with the ball. Three slips and a gully in place...

TOSS - BANGLADESH WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO FIELD! Aiden Markram and Andile Phehlukwayo are making their Test debuts for the Proteas. Bangladesh are going with 3 pacers and a spinner in Mehedi Hasan. Also, Imrul Kayes will open while Liton Das will keep wickets...

Bangladesh, on the other hand, have proved time and again that they are a force to be reckoned. Their performances have come at home and it will be a stern test for them to reflect it in alien conditions this time around. Shakib Al Hasan won't feature for them and the pressure will be on other senior men to deliver the goods. In this part of the world, spinners don't have the upper hand so what pace attack do they stick to is something even we are waiting for. The last time they played a Test in South Africa it happened at this very venue, Potchefstroom in 2002. Will we see Bangladesh giving South Africa a run for their money? Toss and team updates coming up in a bit...

Cricket returns to South Africa and they will welcome the men from Asia, Bangladesh first for a 2-match Test series in their long home season. Having lost the Test series in England, the morale wouldn't be that high but when you play at home it gives you the cushion to start afresh. Ottis Gibson is appointed as their new head coach and it would be interesting to see how this team shapes up under him. Aiden Markram is likely to make his debut and open the batting with Dean Elgar. With their front line pacers being injured, let's see who they opt for.
